about: UltraTech Cement Limited, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the manufacturing, marketing, and distribution of building materials in India and internationally. It offers grey cement, including ordinary Portland, composite, and weather plus, as well as Portland pozzolana, pozzolana super, and slag cement; white cement, wall care putty, and value-added products; and ready-mix concrete.
